numerical_contract: float64 CPU, tiny deterministic original fixtures, no network or data download

topics.outcome: Derive a Bernoulli score and explain why repeated-subject observations do not factor marginally.
Recover the declared weighted objective from unequal partition numerators and masses.
Compare independent analytic, finite-difference and automatic derivatives for normal and decay models.
Distinguish parameter reparameterization from observation and prior density transformations.
Recover Gaussian coefficients and maximum-likelihood scale from an independent least-squares oracle.
Fit a transformed nonlinear curve and diagnose the information lost in a short observation window.
Check stable logistic scores and recognize when separated data have no finite coefficient MLE.
Fit an exposure-adjusted event rate and distinguish expected counts from rates.
Construct event and survival contributions and account for delayed entry in time at risk.
Jointly fit a mean and covariate scale while detecting a missing likelihood normalization term.
Evaluate a stable marginalized mixture and explain label invariance and likelihood degeneracy.
Evaluate complete-panel likelihoods and detect false covariance introduced across subject boundaries.
Distinguish MLE, ridge and MAP and preserve a single global penalty across partitions.
Diagnose redundant parameters and refit nuisance parameters when profiling a nonlinear rate.
Implement deterministic optimizer closures and distinguish returned step loss from final objective.
Verify Hessians independently and detect deliberately broken gradient paths.
Separate mean, observation and new-group uncertainty and distinguish transformed means from medians.
Compare model, iid and cluster variance calculations and enumerate a whole-cluster bootstrap.
Derive the global mean gradient under rank averaging and inspect sampler padding and dropping.
Fit and audit a shared nonlinear panel model with explicit prediction and evidence limitations.

boundaries: No Spark job or distributed process group is launched by this track.
Supplied covariance in prediction examples is not estimated uncertainty.
Synthetic oracle recovery and source tests do not establish interval coverage or production forecasting performance.
Mixture degeneracy, separation, weak identification and boundary estimates are explicitly treated as failures or limits.
